svg.title: minio-from-source: A free MinIO image, built from source.
svg.desc: A newspaper clipping. CONTAINERS. A free MinIO image, built from source. MinIO server and mc built from source at pinned, commit-verified releases. Multi-arch (amd64, arm64) and smoke-tested, a replacement for minio/minio and quay.io/minio. Unofficial. ghcr.io · GitHub Action.
